notes: 3D cameras: smooth follow camera, zone camera cuts between ends instead of flying, no camera jitter, smooth replays, overhead camera white block gone. Puck flow: no snapping onto new carriers, every pass has a swing, no faceoff puck teleport, deflections come off the stick at the right spot. Players: real box exits, smoother hop-ons, fewer one-timer spins, fight punches land. Engine: measured shot power/accuracy, speed vs acceleration, shot blocking and stick checking now count; one-timers only when facing the net. Lines: skill-based chemistry with role tags and links.
